searchQueries.title: Keyword search (title or description)
searchQueries.description: Only keep markets whose question or description contains any of these keywords. Case insensitive. Leave empty to keep everything the API returned.

categories.title: Category shortcut
categories.description: Shortcut for top level Polymarket categories. Options: politics, crypto, sports, technology, music, entertainment, elections, basketball, football, blockchain. Internally resolves to tag IDs. Combine with tagIds below.

tagIds.title: Tag IDs (advanced)
tagIds.description: Raw Polymarket tag IDs if you need a tag outside the category shortcuts. Example: 180 for Israel, 169 for Javier Milei. Browse tags at gamma-api.polymarket.com/tags.

itemType.title: Item type
itemType.description: Markets returns one row per individual market (question + outcomes). Events returns one row per event group (a basket of related markets, like 'Who will win the 2028 election').

status.title: Status
status.description: Active is the default. Closed returns resolved markets. All returns both.

minVolume24h.title: Minimum 24h volume (USD)
minVolume24h.description: Drop markets with less than this much volume in the last 24 hours. Useful when you only want liquid, actively traded markets.

minLiquidity.title: Minimum liquidity (USD)
minLiquidity.description: Drop markets with less than this much resting liquidity on the CLOB. Filters thin books.

minTotalVolume.title: Minimum total volume (USD)
minTotalVolume.description: Drop markets with less than this much lifetime traded volume. Filters toy markets.

minPriceChangePct.title: Minimum price move (%)
minPriceChangePct.description: Only keep markets whose 1 week or 1 month price has moved by at least this many percentage points (absolute value). Set to 0 to disable. Example: 10 returns only markets that moved 10+ points. Applies to markets, not events.

minutesUntilEnd.title: Minimum minutes until end
minutesUntilEnd.description: Drop markets ending sooner than this many minutes from now. Set to 0 to keep everything. Useful to exclude markets too close to resolution for your strategy.

sortBy.title: Sort
sortBy.description: Sort markets before filtering. volume24hr ranks by last 24 hours traded. liquidity ranks by depth. endDate ranks by closest to resolution. startDate returns newest first.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per tag or run
maxItemsPerSource.description: Per tag cap on items processed. Polymarket Gamma returns up to 100 per page; the actor paginates.

maxItemsTotal.title: Maximum items per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap on items pushed to the dataset per run. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip market IDs pushed on previous runs. Stored in the key value store under SEEN_IDS. Turn off to snapshot every run, useful when tracking price moves over time.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. The Polymarket Gamma API is public and does not IP rate limit aggressively, so proxy is rarely needed.
